text: Cell type annotation spatial transcriptomics data subject considerable uncertainty. Transcript diffusion imperfect segmentation assign transcripts neighbouring cells, limited gene panels yield sparse expression profiles, closely related subtypes CD4+ CD8+ T cells frequently misclassified. Downstream analyses nonetheless typically treat annotations fixed, uncertainty propagates, unaccounted , estimates cell type proportions, co-localisation niche composition. fuzzyCell quantifies uncertainty bootstrapping. Within group closely related subtypes, classifier trained original annotations, cell repeatedly reclassified multinomial resampling transcript counts. proportion resamples cell assigned subtype defines confidence subtype. confidences serve soft cell type weights: cell contributes every subtype group proportion confidence, rather single label. analysis can performed original annotations (unweighted) confidence weights (weighted), comparing two identifies conclusions sensitive annotation uncertainty. rest vignette follows workflow real dataset.

title: fuzzyCell: Bootstrap Classification Confidence for Spatial Cell-Type Analysis — fuzzyCell-package
text: Cell type labels spatial single-cell data uncertain, particularly closely related subtypes. fuzzyCell estimates per-cell classification confidence bootstrapping (multinomial resampling cell's counts followed re-classification) uses resulting confidences soft cell type weights. weights propagated downstream analyses: cell type proportions, co-localisation (spicyR's L-function, Statial's Kontextual test relative co-localisation) niche identification (lisaClust), compared analysis using hard labels. Cell types organised user-supplied hierarchy lineages, groups subtypes. Helpers testing sample-level outcomes plotting included.
